source_period: Supplied three-month exports, 6 August through 6 November 2026
rain_labels: Independent station rf in mm checked against rfc at 0.28 mm/tip; complete intervals, or whole-window cumulative counter differences when both boundary readings are present, all observed gauge checks pass and record-ID continuity verifies missing packets. No within-gap timing allocation.
soil_drop_hypothesis: Rain and manual fertigation may both lower srm. Test this against rf; soil drops are never converted into rainfall labels or mm.
neighbor_usage: Past measurements as forecast features and retrospective sensor-consistency evidence; never copy the neighboring gauge into target labels
forecast_update: Hourly replay with the latest then-available archived weekly GFS snapshot; only past received station observations enter features
split_purge: Both issue times and latest future-window label receipt must precede each fitting/validation boundary
model: Fixed LightGBM hurdle model: wet-window classification plus positive window amount regression; shared station model with station identity
selection: Per station/window: amount by validation RMSE; probability by validation Brier score; retain comparison baseline when it is best
baseline: V2 rain recipe refitted using the same past training period, then summed to each window; GFS-window logistic/climatology probability controls. Original fitted V2 models are never applied to earlier test labels.
temperature_and_humidity: Retain V5 outputs unchanged; no temperature or humidity fitting
new_november_comparison: Development diagnostic; earlier X66 November outcomes were already discussed
archive_limitation: Weekly historical forecast snapshots are reused between issues; this does not simulate new hourly GFS runs
publication: Local candidate only; no automatic GitHub publication
